title: A non-extending card isomorphism plus a non-isomorphic hypomorphic partner yields three re-attachments
statement_en: Let n >= 3, G and H graphs on Fin n with G hypomorphic to H and not isomorphic to H, alpha : G - u -> G - u' a card isomorphism and x a neighbour of u with alpha(x) not adjacent to u'. Then there are three pairwise distinct graphs K1, K2, K3, each hypomorphic to G and each agreeing with G on every pair avoiding u': G itself, the graph obtained from G - u' by re-attaching u' to alpha(N(u)) (isomorphic to G, different from G at the pair u', alpha(x)), and the re-attachment of u' along a card isomorphism G - u' -> H - sigma(u') (isomorphic to H). debe_zinchenko.md section 6, paper argument for N.
statement_lean: ∀ n : ℕ, 3 ≤ n → ∀ G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n), ∀ u u' : Fin n, ∀ α : G.induce ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({u'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), ∀ x : ({u}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)), G.Adj u x.1 → ¬ G.Adj u' (α x).1 → Recon.Hypomorphic G H → ¬ Nonempty (G ≃g H) → ∃ K₁ K₂ K₃ : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G K₁ ∧ Recon.Hypomorphic G K₂ ∧ Recon.Hypomorphic G K₃ ∧ (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u' → y ≠ u' → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₁.Adj x y)) ∧ (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u' → y ≠ u' → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₂.Adj x y)) ∧ (∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ u' → y ≠ u' → (G.Adj x y ↔ K₃.Adj x y)) ∧ K₁ ≠ K₂ ∧ K₁ ≠ K₃ ∧ K₂ ≠ K₃
